$comment: Rust HTTP functions that send a request themselves (`ClientSpec` in src/lang/ir/language.ts; `imports` are crate paths with `::` as `.`): reqwest's `reqwest::get(url)` and `reqwest::blocking::get(url)`, isahc's verb functions (`isahc::post(url, body)`, `isahc::get_async(url)`). Requests built with a client's verb call and sent later (reqwest, ureq, awc, surf) are read by requests.ts.
